title: Bodycam Captures Deadly Tornado Response
description:
Where are you most likely to die from a tornado?
Find out: https://www.midwestsafetynews.com/weather/tornado-deaths

TIPS: Submit a tip: 
https://midwest.clickup.com/forms/9006119175/p/f/8ccwy87-63537/H3BKH5EZAPIBRYJ1XB/tips

PRIVACY or COMPLAINTS:
https://midwest.clickup.com/forms/9006119175/f/8ccwy87-63557/LE0PT31DZVHHEIE5AW

Privacy concerns or other complaints? You can also email us: contact@midwest-safety.com

MERCH: Midwest-Safety.com

BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal: https://midwest.clickup.com/forms/9006119175/f/8ccwy87-63557/LE0PT31DZVHHEIE5AW
